note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 5798 Section 8.2.2 says "When a host sends an ND Neighbor Solicitation message for the virtual router IPv6 address, the Virtual Router Master MUST respond to the ND Neighbor Solicitation message with the virtual MAC address for the virtual router." TestVRRPNonOwnerMasterAnswersNDWithVirtualMACOnly and TestVRRPOwnerAnswersWithVirtualMACOnly changed only by the checksum-mode plumbing (a Checksum: packet.ChecksumRFC9568 field added to the GroupSpec, AdvertParams or packet.Local literal, or the mode argument added to packet.FillChecksum); every assertion and every isolating input is byte-for-byte the same; the Neighbor Advertisement captures and their physical-MAC controls are unchanged. Verdict unchanged; the guest records are owed a re-record.
